verdict.rationale: A desktop companion app with visual diff review and side-by-side sessions is a fair question for a coding-agent CLI, so the axis applies. The evidence pack documents only the terminal CLI, GitHub-based automated PR reviews and conversation checkpointing, none of which is a desktop app with visual diffs or parallel session panes. GitHub PR review is an adjacent feature and earns no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can review diffs visually and run multiple sessions side by side in a desktop app
